item.title: Managing This Blog
item.description: This is the first post on my new blog, and fittingly, it’s about how to manage the blog itself. I wanted to document the workflow so future-me doesn’t have to remember all the details. This guide demonstrates how to use markdown and Hugo shortcodes to write useful and nice-looking posts.
